title: 第13章 做鬼很吊吗第14章 你还缺媳妇吗
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
林恩（ー′ー）道：
“你能不能不要发出桀桀桀的笑，给我的观感很差的好不好？你cos武魂殿长老啊？！”
而旁边的花耶已经是颤抖了，小手握在胸前，看着这帅气的一幕，果然知道自己赌对了。
好……好厉害！
果然，能够光光地随便在这个时间段还在外面晃悠的人，绝对是非常厉害和霸气的那种，已经不需要解释了，他绝对是一个非常厉害的驱魔师！！
呜呜！要融化了！
小心肝也在噗通噗通的跳呢！
【叮！花耶对你的崇拜+10】
那个怪诞感觉到了不对劲，目光瞬间变得凶狠，然后一刹那对着林恩张开了血盆巨口，深渊般的巨口几乎要超过林恩的整个脑袋，从里面传来了一阵阵扑鼻的恶臭。
哗————！
眼瞅着就要直接把林恩的脑袋吃掉。
“你的嘴很大的吗？！”
一瞬间，林恩也在瞬间张开了自己的嘴，那嘴刹那间爆涨了几十倍，直接就张到了几乎可以把他直接吞下去的地步。
那个怪诞：“（ΩДΩ）？！！！”
花耶：“（ΩДΩ）哇呀呀呀！！”
【叮！蠕心魔的san值-20！】
【叮！花耶的san值-30！】
不对！
不对劲啊！！
怎么回事！怎么回事啊！！

林恩咔咔地站了起来，而也就是在那个蠕心魔的震惊地注视之下，林恩的双腿开始咔咔暴涨，整个人的身体都像是瘦长鬼影一样高出了他的数倍，巨大的阴影扑面而来，将他笼罩其中。
他惊恐后退，显然没想到会发生这种情况。
“你……你……”
刷刷刷——
他的身上瞬间爆出了十几枚眼球。
“就你眼睛多么？！”
刷刷刷刷刷——
几乎是同一时间，林恩的身上爆炸出了密密麻麻几乎挤满了整个身体的数百颗眼球，全都齐刷刷地对视着他，带着君临的恐怖。
那个怪诞：“（ΩДΩ）？爸爸啊！！！”
花耶：“（ΩДΩ）妈妈啊！！”
【叮！蠕心魔受到了你巨大的惊吓，san值-50！】
【叮！花耶受到了你巨大的震撼，san值-60！】
林恩露出了那不可名状的模样，巨大的阴影铺面而下，咔咔地向他毕竟。
而那个蠕心魔已经是被吓的跌靠在了墙下，和花耶（ΩДΩ）地哆嗦地抱在了一起，吓得已经是躲在了墙角，全身不停地打着颤，已经是被这一幕吓的麻掉了。
“你什么东西？！你……你不是人啊？！！”
林恩用那上百双眼睛俯视着他，咔咔磨牙，脸上的表情说不出的怪诞。
“我最恨别人在我面前装（哔——）了，和谁两呢？这么大个人了，还来这里吓唬小萝莉，你问她我吓过吗？！”
content_en:
Lin En (ー′ー) said:
"Can you please stop making that arrogant smile and giving me a bad impression? Are you cosplaying the elder of Wuhun Palace?!"
Huaye next to him was already trembling, holding his little hands on his chest. Looking at this handsome scene, he knew that he had made the right bet.
So... so awesome!
Sure enough, a person who can hang around outside at this time is definitely a very powerful and domineering person. There is no need to explain, he is definitely a very powerful exorcist! !
Woohoo! It's melting!
My little heart is also jumping with pops and pops!
【bite! Huaye’s admiration for you +10]
The monster sensed that something was wrong, and his eyes instantly became fierce, and then he opened his huge mouth toward Lin En. The abyss-like mouth almost exceeded Lin En's entire head, and bursts of pungent stench came from inside.
Wow————!
He was about to eat Lin En's head right away.
"Do you have a big mouth?!"
In an instant, Lin En also opened his mouth. The mouth suddenly swelled dozens of times, opening it to the point where he could almost swallow him directly.
That weirdness: "(ΩДΩ)?!!!"
Hanaya: "(ΩДΩ) Wow ya ya ya!!"
[Ding! The sanity value of the Heart Creeper is -20! 】
[Ding! Huaye’s san value is -30! 】
No!
Something is wrong! !
What's going on! What's going on! !
Lin stood up suddenly, and under the shocked gaze of the mind-worm, Lin's legs began to swell, and his whole body was like a slender ghost several times taller than him. A huge shadow rushed towards his face and enveloped him.
He recoiled in horror, clearly not expecting this to happen.
"You...you..."
Brush brush brush——
More than a dozen eyeballs exploded from his body instantly.
"Is it just your eyes?!"
Brushing, brushing, brushing——
Almost at the same time, Lin En's body exploded with hundreds of densely packed eyeballs that almost filled the entire body, all staring at him with the terror of King's Landing.
That weird one: "(ΩДΩ)? Dad!!!"
Hanaya: "(ΩДΩ) Mom!!"
[Ding! The Heart Creeper has been greatly frightened by you, and its sanity value is -50! 】
[Ding! Huaye was greatly shocked by you, the san value was -60! 】
Lin En showed that indescribable appearance, and a huge shadow spread down, clicking toward him.
The heart-wrecking demon was so frightened that he fell against the wall and hugged Hua Ye (ΩДΩ) tremblingly. He was so frightened that he hid in the corner, his whole body was trembling, and he was paralyzed by this scene.
"What are you?! You... you are not human?!"
Linn looked down at him with hundreds of pairs of eyes, grinding his teeth, and the expression on his face was indescribably weird.
"What I hate the most is when people pretend to be (beep——) in front of me. Who are they with? Such a big man comes here to scare a little loli. Ask her if I have ever scared her?!"
